The '''Kattada system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kattada/Legends|Kattada]].
